title: Helicopters escorting UFOs into mountains

tellings.quote: The fact that you have helicopters escorting some of these UFOs and UAPs into the mountains,

plain: Helicopters have been seen escorting some UFOs into the mountains, as if guiding them somewhere. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, on an episode with the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a ranch known for reports of strange happenings, and takes it as a hint that someone on the ground knows where these objects go.
